info.title: Kauro API
info.description: Generated by tools/openapi.mjs; do not edit. Operations come from the vendored registry commands.json (provenance-verified); request schemas, the response views derived from the registry contracts, the envelopes and the Problem document are the application-owned schemas the api's closed validator compiles and its send guard validates every reply with.

post.description:
Precondition: No existing membership is assumed. The identity must be verified and creation abuse limits must admit the request.

Effect: Create one draft agency and owner membership atomically; do not activate contracts or billing automatically.

Failure: A repeated identical key returns the same agency; a conflicting key rejects without a second tenant.

201.description: COMPLETED: Create one draft agency and owner membership atomically; do not activate contracts or billing automatically.

AcceptedResponse.title: ACCEPTED
AcceptedResponse.description: Accepted long work: the durable operation reference, its current state, the status path and the polling guidance. None of the B06 commands answers it.

ActiveWorkSummary.title: ActiveWorkSummary
ActiveWorkSummary.description: What archiving a client retained (10 "Archiving a client stops new projects but does not delete active paid work implicitly").

liveCommercialAuthorizations.description: Live commercial authorizations of the client.

AgencyView.title: AgencyView
AgencyView.description: The safe agency view (10 "GET /agencies/{agencyId} returns the safe agency view"), with the caller's permitted actions.
AgencyView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Agency. Withheld: legalProfileRef (Private reviewed customer billing profile (registry description); billing identity is a separate resource (10 "Branding and billing settings are separate resources").); firstQualifyingCaptureId (Commercial designation owned by the payment packages; no B06 route decides it.)

displayName.description: Safe agency label, not a unique legal identity.

permittedActions.description: The caller's capabilities in this agency, derived from the membership role server-side (07 "The handoff to UI includes every state, safe field, permitted action").

ApprovalView.title: ApprovalView
ApprovalView.description: An approval with every member of its KAURO_PLAN_APPROVAL_V1 preimage, so a consumer recomputes approvalHash (reference/HASHING_AND_ACCOUNTING_RULES "the consumer recomputes the relevant preimage").
ApprovalView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Approval. Every registry member is selected.

version.description: Concurrency version of the approval (1 when created, 2 once withdrawn).

actorMembershipId.description: The membership the actor approved under (07 "PlanApproval records actor identity, membership version, assurance evidence").

disclosuresHash.description: UI-disclosed effects, counts, risks and limitations.

approvalHash.description: KAURO_PLAN_APPROVAL_V1 digest of approvalId, actorId, agencyId, planHash, revisionHash, targetContractHash, validationReceiptHash, disclosuresHash and createdAt.

withdrawnByMembershipId.description: The membership that withdrew the approval (CMD026).

withdrawReasonCode.description: The reason the withdrawal named (CMD026 field reasonCode, registry type label).

ApprovePlanCompleted.title: CMD025 COMPLETED
ApprovePlanCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

ApprovePlanView.title: ApprovePlanView
ApprovePlanView.description: CMD025 ApprovePlan result: the immutable approval and the APPROVED plan.

ArchiveClientCompleted.title: CMD010 COMPLETED
ArchiveClientCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

ArchiveClientView.title: ArchiveClientView
ArchiveClientView.description: CMD010 ArchiveClient result: the archived client and the work archiving retained; no deletion, refund or rollback member.

CompletedExternalAction.title: CompletedExternalAction
CompletedExternalAction.description: A completed external or customer action a withdrawal identifies separately and never promises to reverse (CMD026).

referenceId.description: Platform id of the stage or package.

CreateAgencyCompleted.title: CMD001 COMPLETED
CreateAgencyCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

CreateAgencyView.title: CreateAgencyView
CreateAgencyView.description: CMD001 CreateAgency result: the DRAFT agency and the creator's OWNER membership.

CreateClientCompleted.title: CMD009 COMPLETED
CreateClientCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

CreateProjectCompleted.title: CMD011 COMPLETED
CreateProjectCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

EndClientView.title: EndClientView
EndClientView.description: A client workspace with the version its edit commands compare (design D-AGG-2).
EndClientView.$comment: Projection of registry contract EndClient. Every registry member is selected.

version.description: Concurrency version of the client (design D-AGG-2, open question Q3: the registry contract has no version although CMD010 names expectedVersion).

processingAuthorityRef.description: Agency evidence of authority to provide this client's data.

archivedAt.description: When the client was archived (CMD010); present exactly when the state is ARCHIVED.

MembershipView.title: MembershipView
MembershipView.description: Team information appropriate to the caller: no authentication tokens, recovery settings or security evidence (10 "Agency and team routes").
MembershipView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Membership. Every registry member is selected.

PlanImpactMap.title: PlanImpactMap
PlanImpactMap.description: Dependent evidence the revision invalidated (Plan machine "Invalidate only dependent evidence with impact map").

validationReceiptHash.description: The predecessor's receipt, when it was VALIDATED or APPROVED.

approvalId.description: The predecessor's approval, when it was APPROVED.

PlanView.title: PlanView
PlanView.description: A plan revision summary: its lifecycle, its bindings and its lineage. The plan body is not part of a summary.
PlanView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Plan. Withheld: mappings (Plan body (customer field names and decisions, possibly L3/L4 per FIELD_CONTRACTS "Common rules"); served by the plan routes of the audit package, never by a command reply.); identities (Plan body; as mappings.); transforms (Plan body; as mappings.); relationships (Plan body; as mappings.)

bodyHash.description: Digest of immutable plan semantics; lifecycle state/version envelope and final approval are excluded by the named preimage.

validationReceiptHash.description: The current validation receipt of this revision, once validated.

approvalId.description: The approval of this revision, once approved.

supersededByPlanId.description: The successor revision once superseded (design D-PLAN-1).

ProjectView.title: ProjectView
ProjectView.description: A project with its current revision summary and the readiness blockers computed from durable facts at read time (CMD011 effect "visible readiness blockers"; 10 "A UI readiness flag is informative, not authority"). The registry has no Project contract (design D-AGG-1, open question Q4).

targetInstanceRef.description: Declared target instance for a CRM mode (design D-CMD-4).

readinessBlockers.description: Readiness blockers in a fixed order.

RevisePlanCompleted.title: CMD023 COMPLETED
RevisePlanCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

RevisePlanView.title: RevisePlanView
RevisePlanView.description: CMD023 RevisePlan result: the new revision, the superseded predecessor and the impact map.

RevisionSummary.title: RevisionSummary
RevisionSummary.description: The current dataset revision of a project (10 "GET /projects/{projectId} returns the current revision summary").
RevisionSummary.$comment: Projection of registry contract DatasetRevision. Withheld: scope (The tenant scope is the enclosing ProjectView's agencyId, clientId and projectId.); files (Source file manifests are served by the revision routes of the upload package, not by a project summary.); manifestHash (Sealed-source evidence; the plan and approval views carry it as revisionHash once a plan binds it.); projectionHash (Parser/projection evidence of the upload package.); sealedAt (Served by the revision routes of the upload package.); supersedesRevisionId (Lineage is served by the revision routes of the upload package.)

SupersededPlanSummary.title: SupersededPlanSummary
SupersededPlanSummary.description: The predecessor revision after RevisePlan: SUPERSEDED at its new version.

WithdrawApprovalCompleted.title: CMD026 COMPLETED
WithdrawApprovalCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

WithdrawApprovalView.title: WithdrawApprovalView
WithdrawApprovalView.description: CMD026 WithdrawApproval result: the withdrawn approval, the WITHDRAWN plan and the completed external actions, identified separately; no rollback or refund member.

completedExternalActions.description: Completed external or customer actions, never promised reversible.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every command (10 "Idempotency contract"); a retry after a lost response reuses it.

AgencySelector.name: X-Kauro-Agency
AgencySelector.description: The active agency context of a route whose path carries no agencyId (design D-SCOPE-1): a selector, never authority.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Opaque correlation id (10 "Request envelope"): adopted when it is an id of this shape; any other value is ignored — never refused, never echoed — and the server mints one, as when it is absent (review decision E-CORR-1). Every reply carries the id the request was handled under.
The correlation id of the request, on every reply.
